name: Andaz San Diego
insider_take: Modern luxury meets California cool in the heart of the Gaslamp Quarter, where every corner tells a story of San Diego's vibrant past and present.
whats_special: The Andaz San Diego occupies a stunning 1913 historic building that once housed the Santa Fe Depot baggage building. This architectural gem seamlessly blends its railway heritage with contemporary design, featuring exposed brick walls, soaring ceilings, and original hardwood floors. The rooftop terrace offers breathtaking views of Petco Park and San Diego Bay, making it one of the city's most coveted sunset spots.
pro_tip: Book a corner suite on the upper floors during baseball season – you'll have prime views of Padres games at Petco Park just two blocks away, plus complimentary snacks and non-alcoholic beverages as part of the Andaz experience.
dont_miss: The hotel's location puts you steps from the historic Gaslamp Quarter's Victorian-era gas lamp posts (the only authentic ones left from the 1880s), world-class craft breweries, and the famous Saturday farmers market at nearby Horton Plaza Park. The concierge can arrange exclusive after-hours access to the USS Midway Museum, just a 10-minute walk along the scenic harbor.
pros: Prime downtown location in Gaslamp Quarter
Modern stylish design with contemporary amenities
Rooftop bar with panoramic city and bay views
Exceptional personalized service and local experiences
cons: Urban setting with potential street noise
